The structure of Sc3Al6Co6 (reduced formula Sc(AlCo)2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 15 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies 8-fold coordination for all three elements: Al and Co centers each have 4 Al and 4 Co neighbors, while Sc centers have 8 Co neighbors, with all neighbor distances at 2.6243 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 15 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner and edge sharing between Al and Co 8-vertex coordination polyhedra, and corner sharing between Al and Sc 8-vertex polyhedra.
